in_sanskrit.name: Mk
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fire
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mk एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mk is a Sanskrit name derived from the god Agni, the god of fire in Hindu mythology. Agni is considered the god of the hearth and the sacred fire, representing the purifying and transformative power of fire. The name Mk is believed to bestow upon the bearer the strength, courage, and wisdom of this powerful deity.
